cohort: The study included 25 fetuses diagnosed with intra-hepatic Umbilical-Porto-Systemic Venous Shunt (IHUPSVS) between 2001 and 2019.
finding: Growth restriction is prevalent in fetuses with intra-hepatic Umbilical-Porto-Systemic Venous Shunt (IHUPSVS).
birth_weight: 72% of included fetuses had birth weight below the 10th centile, with 16% between the third and fifth centile, and 44% below the third centile.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery for included fetuses was 37 weeks for those with FGR and 38 weeks for those appropriate for gestational age (AGA).
